set.body:
Acceptance criteria:
- alpha, regularization, tolerances, iterations, ranks, costs, weights, and starts validate consistently.
- Empty, singleton, zero/concentrated weight, non-finite, and extreme-scale behavior is explicit.
- R and C++ entry points fail consistently without crashes.
- All flagship functions and precision modes receive validation tests.
- Automatic weight normalization is documented and tested.
set.title: Harden parameter validation and degenerate-mass behavior
